name: Distrito (INEI)
source: INEI ubigeo, 2016 revision — the last INEI published — via github.com/ernestorivero/Ubigeo-Peru (json/ubigeo_peru_2016_*.json). Validated structurally before use: 25 departamentos, 196 provincias, 1874 distritos, every child resolving to a real parent, every código prefix-consistent with its parents (010101 -> 0101 -> 01), no duplicates. 1874 is the published INEI count. NOT taken from perunio-frontend/src/data/ubigeo-peru.ts, which covered 536 distritos and was wrong about them: 55 carried the código of a different district (it placed CHIMBOTE at 022001 when INEI has it at 021801) and 29 códigos were not INEI ubigeos at all. goConsts is false: nothing refers to a distrito by name, and 1874 named Go constants would be noise. The map, Codes slice and lookups are still generated, which is what the GRE validator needs.
